title: How to Run AI Models Locally With Ollama and LM Studio - Agentic Times | AgentLocker

facts.fact: Open-weight AI models trail the best closed models by about four months on average, according to Epoch AI's May 29 analysis covering the period since January 2026 (third-party figure cited by the article).
facts.quote: Open-weight AI models now trail the best closed models by about four months on average.

facts.fact: Paid chatbot subscriptions cost about $20 a month, while Ollama and LM Studio cost nothing.
facts.quote: Paid chatbot subscriptions cost about $20 a month, while these tools cost nothing.

facts.fact: Ollama and LM Studio are free programs.
facts.quote: Two free programs, Ollama and LM Studio, handle the setup.

facts.fact: LM Studio's documentation says the app can operate entirely offline, provided the user first gets model files.
facts.quote: can operate entirely offline, just make sure to get some model files first.

facts.fact: DeepSeek's R1 series uses the MIT License.
facts.quote: DeepSeek’s R1 series uses the MIT License

facts.fact: Google's Gemma 4 and OpenAI's gpt-oss use the Apache 2.0 license, which allows changes and commercial use.
facts.quote: Google’s Gemma 4 and OpenAI’s gpt-oss use Apache 2.0.

facts.fact: Small local AI models need about 8GB of VRAM.
facts.quote: Small models need about 8GB of VRAM.

facts.fact: Heavier local AI users may want a graphics card with 24GB or more of VRAM, or unified-memory machines such as the Mac Mini or Nvidia DGX Spark.
facts.quote: Heavier users may want a graphics card with 24GB or more, or machines with unified memory such as the Mac Mini or the Nvidia DGX Spark.

facts.fact: LM Studio recommends 16GB or more of RAM on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or newer.
facts.quote: LM Studio recommends 16GB or more of RAM on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or newer.

facts.fact: On Windows, LM Studio recommends 16GB of RAM and 4GB of dedicated VRAM.
facts.quote: On Windows, it recommends 16GB of RAM and 4GB of dedicated VRAM.

facts.fact: LM Studio does not support Intel-based Macs.
Ollama lists Gemma 4 model downloads at about 4.6GB to 20GB.
facts.quote: Ollama lists Gemma 4 downloads from about 4.6GB to 20GB.

facts.fact: OpenAI says the gpt-oss-20b model needs 16GB of memory.
facts.quote: OpenAI says gpt-oss-20b needs 16GB of memory

facts.fact: OpenAI says the gpt-oss-120b model runs within 80GB.
Google claims its Multi-Token Prediction drafters for Gemma 4 can speed up responses by up to 3x.
facts.quote: Google’s Multi-Token Prediction drafters for Gemma 4 can speed up responses by up to 3x.

facts.fact: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8-Max has 2.4 trillion total parameters.
facts.quote: Alibaba’s Qwen 3.8-Max has 2.4 trillion total parameters

facts.fact: In Alibaba's own comparison, closed models won 24 of 31 tests against Qwen 3.8-Max (vendor-reported result).
facts.quote: in Alibaba’s own comparison, closed models won 24 of 31 tests.

facts.fact: Models ending in ':cloud' run on Ollama's servers instead of the user's machine.
facts.quote: Models ending in “:cloud” run on Ollama’s servers instead of the user’s machine.
